AudioStimulus.description: Auditory stimulus parameters common to all trials.

speakerLocations.description: Candidate lateral sound positions, one drawn per audio trial; no azimuth-0 entry, the centre sound of visual-only and neutral trials is fixed in code
speakerLocations.title: SpeakerLocations

AudioStimulus.title: AudioStimulus

OptogeneticsSettings.description:
Zapit optogenetic stimulation parameters. Names as coen-dome-navigation's where they mean the same (Pip,
9 Nov 2026); laser_duration_seconds is a timed stimulus here, where the corridor's laserMaxSeconds is a cap.

useZapit.description: Whether Zapit runs this experiment: each laser-on trial sends it a condition (laser-off trials send nothing), and rig-control checks Zapit is answering before Go
useZapit.title: UseZapit

zapitConfigPath.description: Path to the Zapit conditions file (the one loaded in Zapit) listing the stimulation conditions. Named ...ConfigPath so rig-control keeps a copy beside the task file at Go
zapitConfigPath.title: ZapitConfigPath

laserPowerMw.description: Laser power on laser-on trials, in mW, the same for every condition: sent to Zapit with each StartStimulus (overriding the conditions file's power) and logged as laserPowerMw (0 on laser-off trials). Required with optogenetics on
laserPowerMw.title: LaserPowerMw

laserOnProbability.description: Probability that a trial after trials_before_laser is a laser-on trial
laserOnProbability.title: LaserOnProbability

laserDurationSeconds.description: How long the laser stays on, in seconds (a timed stimulus)
laserDurationSeconds.title: LaserDurationSeconds

laserToStimulusSeconds.description: From the trial's laser trigger (zapit.triggerLine) to the trial's stimulus, in seconds, on every trial, laser on or off and with or without Zapit: Bonsai waits this long on the Harp clock after the trigger, then commands the stimulus (stimulusOnsetTime, within a few ms; the screen and sound card add their own latency). On a rig without hardware triggering the laser starts when Zapit gets the command, 0.1 s before the trigger
laserToStimulusSeconds.title: LaserToStimulusSeconds

noLaserOnRepeats.description: Whether repeat trials never have the laser on
noLaserOnRepeats.title: NoLaserOnRepeats

trialsBeforeLaser.description: Trials at the experiment's start with no laser-on trial among them (repeats included, as in trialNumber)
trialsBeforeLaser.title: TrialsBeforeLaser

OptogeneticsSettings.title: OptogeneticsSettings

Punishment.description:
What an error costs, as the lab's tasks name it (the trial log's punishSound and punishTimeoutSeconds):
the timeout after an incorrect response or a miss (a miss on an auto-reward trial is rewarded instead), and
the error sound on an incorrect response.

timeoutSeconds.description: Timeout after an incorrect response or a miss, in seconds
timeoutSeconds.title: TimeoutSeconds

sound.description: The error sound on an incorrect response
sound.title: Sound

Punishment.title: Punishment

PunishmentSound.description: The error sound played on an incorrect response.

enabled.description: Whether the error sound plays on incorrect responses
enabled.title: Enabled

path.description: Wav file of the error sound
path.title: Path

channel.description: Mixer output channel the error sound plays on
channel.title: Channel

gain.description: Playback gain of the error sound
gain.title: Gain

PunishmentSound.title: PunishmentSound

RepeatRule.description: When a trial type is repeated after a failed trial.
RepeatRule.title: RepeatRule

maxRepeats.description: Maximum number of consecutive repeats of the same trial
maxRepeats.title: MaxRepeats

rulesPerType.description: Repeat rule per trial type, indexed by trial type
rulesPerType.title: RulesPerType

ResponseSettings.description: Lick-accumulation response rule; thresholdLicks 1 with degreesPerLick 0 is classic first-lick 2AFC.

thresholdLicks.description: Net lick difference (left minus right, absolute) that terminates the response window
thresholdLicks.title: ThresholdLicks

degreesPerLick.description: Degrees the grating azimuth moves per net lick difference; 0 keeps the stimulus fixed
degreesPerLick.title: DegreesPerLick

ResponseSettings.title: ResponseSettings

RewardSettings.description: Reward delivery parameters; per-stage reward size lives in the training stage table.

rewardProbability.description: Meant as the probability that a correct response is rewarded. Not used: every correct response is rewarded, whatever its value (BACKLOG)
rewardProbability.title: RewardProbability

largeRewardMultiplier.description: Reward size multiplier applied on large-reward trials
largeRewardMultiplier.title: LargeRewardMultiplier

largeRewardProbability.description: Probability that a trial is a large-reward trial
largeRewardProbability.title: LargeRewardProbability

RewardSettings.title: RewardSettings

SphericalPosition.description: A position on a sphere centred on the subject.

azimuth.description: Azimuth, in degrees. Zero is straight ahead, positive to the right.
azimuth.title: Azimuth

elevation.description: Elevation, in degrees. Zero is the horizontal plane.
elevation.title: Elevation

radius.description: Distance from the subject, in metres.
radius.title: Radius

SphericalPosition.title: SphericalPosition

TrainingStage.description: One complete row of the training stage table; stages are selected by index at runtime.

label.description: Human-readable stage name, for documentation and logs
label.title: Label

trialWeights.description: Relative draw weight per trial type, indexed by trial type: each new trial draws its type at random with these as relative chances, independently of every other trial (repeats copy the trial they repeat)
trialWeights.title: TrialWeights

autoRewardProbability.description: Probability that a trial is an auto-reward trial: a miss on it is rewarded at the target spout, and still counts as a timeout for repeats
autoRewardProbability.title: AutoRewardProbability

bothSpoutsProbability.description: Probability that both spouts are presented rather than only the correct one
bothSpoutsProbability.title: BothSpoutsProbability

rewardSizeUl.description: Reward size, in microliters. The valve's calibration plans the pulses; an uncalibrated valve gives ceil(size/2) pulses of rig.yml's width, taken as 2 ul each (RewardLine)
rewardSizeUl.title: RewardSizeUl

contrasts.description: Candidate grating contrasts to draw from on visual trials
contrasts.title: Contrasts

allowRepeats.description: Whether failed trials may be repeated in this stage
allowRepeats.title: AllowRepeats

spoutMovements.description: Whether the spouts move during trials; false keeps them in (habituation): no withdrawal and no single-spout move for a reward
spoutMovements.title: SpoutMovements

TrainingStage.title: TrainingStage

TrialStructure.description: Timing parameters of the trial state machine.

itiMinSeconds.description: Lower bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds, from the outcome (after any punishment timeout) to the next stimulus. It includes 2 s to drink, 0.1 s to arm Zapit and optogenetics.laserToStimulusSeconds, so a draw shorter than 2.1 s plus laserToStimulusSeconds runs as that
itiMinSeconds.title: ItiMinSeconds

itiMaxSeconds.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn inter-trial interval, in seconds; it includes 2 s to drink, 0.1 s to arm Zapit and optogenetics.laserToStimulusSeconds (itiMinSeconds)
itiMaxSeconds.title: ItiMaxSeconds

quiescentMinSeconds.description: Lower bound of a quiescent period drawn per trial, in seconds. Not used: the workflow has no quiescent wait, so changing it changes nothing (BACKLOG)
quiescentMinSeconds.title: QuiescentMinSeconds

quiescentMaxSeconds.description: Upper bound of a quiescent period drawn per trial, in seconds. Not used: the workflow has no quiescent wait, so changing it changes nothing (BACKLOG)
quiescentMaxSeconds.title: QuiescentMaxSeconds

openLoopSeconds.description: Open-loop period after stimulus onset, in seconds
openLoopSeconds.title: OpenLoopSeconds

stimulusToSpoutsInSeconds.description: From stimulus onset to moving the response spouts in, in seconds (spoutInDelaySeconds until 10 Nov 2026)
stimulusToSpoutsInSeconds.title: StimulusToSpoutsInSeconds

TrialStructure.title: TrialStructure

UclOpenAvDomeTaskLogic.title: UclOpenAvDomeTaskLogic

UclOpenAvDomeTaskParameters.description: Task parameters for the av-dome audiovisual tasks: localization and discrimination.

rngSeed.description: Seed of the random number generator for these task parameters
rngSeed.title: RngSeed

taskType.description: localization: the answer is the side the stimulus came from. discrimination: the answer is the modality, the left spout for targetModality and the right spout for the other; trial types 0 and 1 are then target and distractor trials

targetModality.description: Discrimination only: the modality answered at the left spout
targetModality.title: TargetModality

trialStructure.description: Timing parameters of the trial state machine

punishment.description: The timeout and error sound an error costs

trainingStages.description: Training stage table indexed by stage id; ids past the end clamp to the last row
trainingStages.title: TrainingStages

UclOpenAvDomeTaskParameters.title: UclOpenAvDomeTaskParameters

VisualStimulus.description: Grating stimulus parameters common to all trials; contrast is set per training stage.

azimuthMinDeg.description: Lower bound of the uniformly drawn grating azimuth, in degrees
azimuthMinDeg.title: AzimuthMinDeg

azimuthMaxDeg.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn grating azimuth, in degrees
azimuthMaxDeg.title: AzimuthMaxDeg

fixedAzimuthsDeg.description: Discrete grating azimuths, in degrees; when set and non-empty, every trial draws from this list (filtered to the trial's side, capped on coherent trials) instead of [azimuthMinDeg, azimuthMaxDeg]
fixedAzimuthsDeg.title: FixedAzimuthsDeg

elevationMinDeg.description: Lower bound of the uniformly drawn grating elevation, in degrees
elevationMinDeg.title: ElevationMinDeg

elevationMaxDeg.description: Upper bound of the uniformly drawn grating elevation, in degrees
elevationMaxDeg.title: ElevationMaxDeg

coherentAzimuthCapDeg.description: On coherent trials the grating azimuth magnitude is kept below this cap, in degrees
coherentAzimuthCapDeg.title: CoherentAzimuthCapDeg

gaussianWindowSigmaDeg.description: Sigma of the Gaussian aperture window, in degrees
gaussianWindowSigmaDeg.title: GaussianWindowSigmaDeg

orientationDeg.description: Grating stripe orientation, in degrees; drift direction is orthogonal to it (orientationDeg + 90 degrees)
orientationDeg.title: OrientationDeg

spatialFrequencyCpd.description: Grating spatial frequency, in cycles per degree
spatialFrequencyCpd.title: SpatialFrequencyCpd

temporalFrequencyHz.description: Unsigned grating drift rate, in Hz, drifting orthogonal to orientationDeg (orientationDeg + 90 degrees); 0 is static
temporalFrequencyHz.title: TemporalFrequencyHz
